title: Unlocking the potential of CRISPR tools and databases for precision genome editing
relevance_to_cellguide: Review article surveying current CRISPR guide-design/off-target/screening tools (including CRISPOR, CHOPCHOP, ML trends) — useful orientation reading for Workstream B1 tool selection, though published in a plant-science journal so some content may be plant-specific; treat as a general tool-landscape overview, not a primary source.
